image_processing: None. Original PNG captures copied without editing.
limitations: Short scripted single-player runs. Not a performance benchmark, gameplay acceptance test or multiplayer test. Development settings and support allocation are not representative of balanced gameplay. Terrain and aircraft include native Nuclear Option assets. The hero frame comes from a run whose later MET-console section failed on a stale set-piece press (since removed from the scenario); the hero section itself completed before the failure. The storm frame shows heavy overcast: the pinned sky's convection sat out of frame, so the caption says overcast, not a thunderhead. The weather console's METAR line reports the pinned sky instance's real layers, which include a high veil besides the card's nominal low cumulus (FEW049), so the METAR cloud base differs from the card's catalog code while the Sky Overhead readout agrees with the card.
